title: Memories of a Dying Industry: Sense and Identity in a British Paper Mill
version: The Senses & Society 12(1), 35–52, author postprint, DOI 10.1080/17458927.2016.1268819
lineage: 2017 historical and ethnographic author postprint; first-hand observation in 2013, historical mill chronology based partly on earlier sources. The reproduced photo captions are described; the photographs are not included in the postprint.

passages.note: Author reports observing Jim Patterson and Gary Fuller operate the 1902 pilot papermaking machine in January 2013.

passages.locator: Postprint PDF pp. 9–11, history of No. 2 and Rotiformer
passages.note: 1907 No. 2 commissioning caption; early-1960s Rotiformer acquisition, working losses and early-1970s shutdown; No. 2 ran until May 2009.
Identifies the 2013 pilot machine’s Fourdrinier table; the figure itself is not included in this postprint.
